title: 辦公室印表機報修

dialogue.text: Hi, this is Dana from the sales team on the fourth floor. Our printer's giving us trouble again.
The big one next to the copy room?
That's the one. It keeps jamming, and now there's a message on the screen about the paper tray.
Did you try pulling the tray out and reloading the paper?
Twice. Same message. And it's making a strange noise when it starts up.
Well, that sounds like more than a paper jam. I'll have to send a technician over.
How soon? We've got a client meeting at two, and I need forty copies of a report before then.
Hmm. Our technician's at another building this morning. He won't be back until around one.
That's cutting it close.
Actually, why don't you use the printer on the third floor? It's the same model, so your settings will work.
Good idea. Could you put in the repair request while I go down there?
Sure, I'll enter it now. You'll get an email with the ticket number.

questions.q: What problem does the woman report?
options: A computer will not turn on.
questions.explanation: 女子第三句說 It keeps jamming, and now there's a message on the screen about the paper tray（一直卡紙，螢幕還跳出紙匣訊息），故選印表機一直卡紙。第一句只提到 printer's giving us trouble，尚未點名問題，真正的定位句在第三句。

questions.q: Why is the woman concerned about the time?
options: She has to leave the office early.
The building closes at one o'clock.
She needs copies for a two o'clock meeting.
questions.explanation: 女子問 How soon? 之後緊接著說 We've got a client meeting at two, and I need forty copies of a report before then（兩點有客戶會議，之前要四十份報告），這是她急的原因。男子說技術人員一點才回來，是造成時間緊的另一方，不是她擔心的內容本身。

questions.q: What does the man suggest the woman do?
options: Use a printer on another floor.
Buy paper from the supply room.
questions.explanation: 男子倒數第三句說 why don't you use the printer on the third floor?（何不先用三樓那台），why don't you 是典型的建議句型，答案就在這句。後面 It's the same model 是補充理由。

transcriptZh:
女：你好，我是四樓業務部的 Dana。我們的印表機又出狀況了。
男：是影印室旁邊那台大的嗎？
女：就是那台。它一直卡紙，現在螢幕上還跳出紙匣的訊息。
男：你有把紙匣拉出來、重新放紙嗎？
女：試了兩次，還是同樣的訊息。而且開機的時候會發出怪聲。
男：嗯，這聽起來不只是卡紙。我得派技術人員過去。
女：多快能來？我們兩點有客戶會議，在那之前我需要四十份報告。
男：這個嘛，我們的技術人員今天早上在另一棟大樓，大概一點才會回來。
女：那時間就很趕了。
男：其實，你要不要先用三樓的印表機？機型一樣，你的設定可以直接沿用。
女：好主意。我下去印的時候，可以麻煩你先幫我報修嗎？
男：沒問題，我現在就登記。你會收到一封有維修單號的電子郵件。

title: 預算會議改期協調

dialogue.text: Karen, do you have a second? It's about Thursday's budget meeting.
Sure, what's up?
I just found out our director has to fly to Osaka Wednesday night. He won't be back until Friday afternoon.
So he'd miss the whole thing. Can't we just go ahead without him?
I'd rather not. He's the one who signs off on the numbers.
All right, then let's move it. How about Monday morning?
Monday's tough. That's when the quarterly reports are due.
Then Tuesday at ten. That works for me.
Same here. But the big conference room is used for training on Tuesdays.
We can take the small one on the second floor. There'll only be six of us.
Fine with me. Could you send out a new invitation this afternoon and attach the updated spreadsheet?
Will do. Some people still haven't seen the latest version anyway.

questions.q: Why does the man want to change the meeting?
options: The conference room is being repainted.
The budget numbers are not ready.
The director will be away on a trip.
questions.explanation: 男子第二句說 our director has to fly to Osaka Wednesday night. He won't be back until Friday afternoon（總監週三晚上要飛大阪，週五下午才回來），女子接著說 So he'd miss the whole thing，確認就是總監出差。會議室的問題出現在後半段，是新時段才衍生的，不是改期原因。

questions.q: What problem does the man mention about Monday?
options: Quarterly reports are due that day.
He will be out of the office.
The room is used for training.
questions.explanation: 女子提議 How about Monday morning? 男子回 Monday's tough. That's when the quarterly reports are due（季報那天要交）。選項 C 的教育訓練是「週二」大會議室的狀況，屬時間錯置的干擾選項。

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to include?
questions.explanation: 男子最後一句 Could you send out a new invitation this afternoon and attach the updated spreadsheet?（下午發新的會議邀請，並附上更新後的試算表），attach 後面接的就是答案。

transcriptZh:
男：Karen，有空講一下嗎？是關於週四的預算會議。
女：可以啊，怎麼了？
男：我剛得知我們總監週三晚上要飛大阪，週五下午才會回來。
女：那他整場都會錯過。我們不能直接開嗎？
男：我不太想。數字最後是他簽核的。
女：好吧，那就改期。週一早上如何？
男：週一很難，那天季報要交。
女：那週二十點吧，我可以。
男：我也可以。不過大會議室週二都拿來做教育訓練。
女：那就用二樓那間小的，我們只有六個人。
男：我沒問題。可以請你今天下午發新的會議邀請，並附上更新後的試算表嗎？
女：沒問題。反正還有些人沒看過最新版。

title: 新進員工詢問報帳流程

dialogue.text: Excuse me, are you Ms. Patel from accounting?
I am. And you must be the new hire in marketing.
That's right, I started Monday. I took a client to lunch yesterday, and I'm not sure how to get my money back.
No problem. Did you keep the receipt?
I've got it right here.
Good. First, scan it and upload it to the expense system. It's the icon on your desktop called ExpenseTrack.
Do I need my manager to approve it?
Anything over fifty dollars, yes. Under that, it goes straight through.
This one was seventy-two.
Then send it to your manager after you upload it. She'll get an automatic notification.
How long before I see the money?
We pay out every other Friday. If you submit today, it'll be in your account on the twentieth.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: How to get paid back for a business expense
How to book a meeting room
Where to take a client for lunch
When a new employee will start
questions.explanation: 男子第二句就點題：I took a client to lunch yesterday, and I'm not sure how to get my money back（不知道怎麼把錢請回來），之後全段都在講上傳收據、主管核准、撥款時間，主旨即報帳流程。午餐與到職日只是背景資訊。

questions.q: Why does the man need his manager's approval?
options: He is still in his first month.
He paid with a company card.
The amount is over fifty dollars.
questions.explanation: 女子說 Anything over fifty dollars, yes（超過五十美元就要核准），男子接著說 This one was seventy-two（這筆是七十二），兩句合起來才是答案。只聽到 fifty 或 seventy-two 其中一句都不夠。

questions.q: What will the man most likely do next?
options: Meet with his manager in person
Upload the receipt to the system
Call the restaurant for a copy
questions.explanation: 女子指示的第一步是 First, scan it and upload it to the expense system，而且男子說收據 I've got it right here（就在手上），所以下一步是掃描上傳。送交主管是 after you upload it 之後的事，順序在後。

transcriptZh:
男：不好意思，請問您是會計部的 Patel 小姐嗎？
女：是我。你應該就是行銷部新來的同事吧。
男：對，我週一報到的。我昨天帶客戶去吃午餐，不太確定要怎麼把錢請回來。
女：沒問題。收據有留著嗎？
男：就在我手上。
女：很好。第一步，把收據掃描後上傳到費用系統，就是你桌面上那個叫 ExpenseTrack 的圖示。
男：需要我主管核准嗎？
女：超過五十美元就需要。五十以下會直接過。
男：這筆是七十二。
女：那你上傳完之後送交給主管，系統會自動通知她。
男：大概多久會拿到錢？
女：我們每兩週的星期五撥款一次。你今天送出的話，二十號就會入帳。

title: 餐廳訂位變更

dialogue.text: Good morning. I'd like to change a reservation for tonight.
Of course. Could I have the name, please?
It's under Brian Hollis. Six people at seven o'clock.
I see it here. What would you like to change?
Two more people are coming, so we'll need a table for eight. And could we push it back to seven thirty?
Let me check. Seven thirty is fine, but I don't have a window table for eight at that hour. I could put you in the back room.
Is it quiet back there? We're celebrating a retirement, so a few people want to make speeches.
It's the quietest part of the restaurant, actually. It's a private room, though, so there's a minimum charge of three hundred dollars.
With eight of us ordering dinner, we'll pass that easily.
Then I'll put you down for the back room at seven thirty. Oh, would you like me to order a cake?
Yes, please. Chocolate. And could you have them write "Congratulations, Wendy" on it?
I'll take care of it. See you tonight, Mr. Hollis.

questions.explanation: 男子開場就說 I'd like to change a reservation for tonight（想更改今晚的訂位），後面改人數、改時間都在呼應這個目的。

questions.q: What does the woman say about the back room?
questions.explanation: 女子說 It's a private room, though, so there's a minimum charge of three hundred dollars（是包廂，有三百美元的低消）。她同時說那裡最安靜，但選項沒有這一項；只有低消是被明確提到的條件。

questions.q: What will the woman most likely do?
options: Move the party to a window table
Order a cake with a message
questions.explanation: 女子問 would you like me to order a cake?，男子回 Yes, please. Chocolate，還要求寫上 Congratulations, Wendy，女子最後說 I'll take care of it，所以她會去訂一個有字樣的蛋糕。靠窗座位那時段沒有八人桌，已被排除。

transcriptZh:
男：早安，我想更改今晚的訂位。
女：好的，請問訂位大名？
男：登記的是 Brian Hollis，六位，七點。
女：我看到了。您想更改哪個部分呢？
男：又多了兩個人要來，所以需要八人桌。另外可以往後改到七點半嗎？
女：我查一下。七點半沒問題，但那個時段沒有八人的靠窗座位。我可以安排您在後面那間。
男：後面那間安靜嗎？我們是要慶祝退休，會有幾個人想致詞。
女：那其實是餐廳裡最安靜的地方。不過那是包廂，所以有三百美元的低消。
男：八個人吃晚餐，這金額很輕鬆就過了。
女：那我幫您登記七點半、後面那間包廂。對了，需要我幫您訂蛋糕嗎？
男：好，麻煩了，巧克力口味。可以請他們寫上「Congratulations, Wendy」嗎？
女：我來處理。Hollis 先生，今晚見。

title: 出差行程確認

dialogue.text: Mark, I've got your Chicago trip all set. Do you want to go through it now?
Please. I've been meaning to ask about the flights.
You leave Tuesday at six fifteen in the morning and land a little after eight.
Six fifteen? So I'd be walking out my door at four.
Sorry about that. The next one doesn't get in until eleven, and your first meeting starts at ten.
All right, no way around it. What about the hotel?
The Lakeside Inn, three nights. It's a ten-minute walk from the client's office, so you won't need a car.
Good, I hate driving downtown. And coming back?
Friday at four in the afternoon. That leaves the morning open for the factory tour.
Oh, the tour got moved to Thursday. So Friday morning's free now.
Then let me see what's available earlier. There'd be a change fee, though. About eighty dollars.
Go ahead. I just have to be home by seven for my daughter's game.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: A change in a client contract
questions.explanation: 女子開場說 I've got your Chicago trip all set. Do you want to go through it now?（芝加哥出差都安排好了，要不要現在核對），接著逐項談班機、飯店、回程，主旨是出差行程安排。

questions.q: Why did the woman book the early morning flight?
options: The man asked for a window seat.
A later flight would arrive after a meeting begins.
questions.explanation: 女子說 The next one doesn't get in until eleven, and your first meeting starts at ten（下一班十一點才到，但第一場會議十點開始），所以只能訂早班機。這題要把兩個時間對起來才選得出來。

questions.q: What will the woman most likely do next?
options: Look for an earlier return flight
questions.explanation: 男子說 the tour got moved to Thursday. So Friday morning's free now，女子隨即回 let me see what's available earlier（我看看有沒有更早的），男子又說 Go ahead，可見她會去查更早的回程班機。工廠參觀是「已經被改期」，不是她要去改。

transcriptZh:
女：Mark，你的芝加哥出差都安排好了。要現在核對一下嗎？
男：好啊，我一直想問班機的事。
女：你星期二早上六點十五分起飛，八點多一點降落。
男：六點十五分？那我四點就得出門了。
女：抱歉。下一班要十一點才到，可是你第一場會議十點就開始。
男：好吧，那也沒辦法。飯店呢？
女：Lakeside Inn，住三晚。走路到客戶辦公室十分鐘，所以你不用租車。
男：太好了，我很討厭在市中心開車。那回程呢？
女：星期五下午四點。早上剛好可以去參觀工廠。
男：喔，那個參觀改到星期四了。所以星期五早上現在空著。
女：那我看看有沒有更早的班機。不過會有改票費，大概八十美元。
男：改吧。我只要七點前到家，趕上我女兒的比賽就好。
